{{Top|rwm|ref|reb|italics=1}} {{Otheruses|Core Rulebook}} {{ReferenceBook |image=[[File:StarWars-ForceAndDestinyCoreRulebook.png]] |title=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook'' |author=*[[Jay Little]] {{C|Designer}}''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook *[[Sam Stewart]] {{C|Developer}} *[[Max Brooke]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[Daniel Clark]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[John Dunn]] *[[Keith Kappel]] *[[Corey Konieczka]] *[[Monte Lin]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[Jason Marker]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[Jason Mical]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[Katrina Ostrander]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[Christopher Rowe]] {{C|Contributing author}} *[[Andrew Fischer]] {{C|Contributing author}} |cover artist=*[[Darren Tan]] {{C|Front cover art}} |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Fantasy Flight Games]]{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/2/9/use-the-force-rpg|text=Use the Force}} |release date=[[July 30]], [[2015]]{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/7/30/take-up-your-destiny|text=Take Up Your Destiny}} |type= |pages=448 |dimensions= |weight= |isbn=9781633441224 |series=''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook''''' is the primary guide to [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]]. It was released after the game's [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|beta test]], on [[July 30]], [[2015]]. The book includes the introductory campaign ''[[Lessons from the Past]]''. ==Publisher's summary== ''Use the full power of the Force in the epic adventures of the ''Force and Destiny'' roleplaying game! You can travel the galaxy in search of ancient Jedi knowledge, protect the downtrodden on your home planet, or pilot a starship for the Rebellion. Whatever your path, the ''Force and Destiny Core'' Rulebook contains all the information players and Game Masters need to launch a roleplaying campaign set in the ''Star Wars®'' universe.'' The beautifully illustrated, 448-page Core Rulebook details everything from using the narrative dice system in combat and creating Force-sensitive characters to the mythology of the Jedi order and locations inside Sith space. It is the fundamental book and launching point for any ''Force and Destiny'' campaign. The ''Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook features: *An introduction to roleplaying in the Star Wars universe *Clear and concise rules for skill checks, combat, and using the Force *Six careers, eight species, and eighteen specializations for Force-sensitive characters *Detailed background information on galactic geography, politics, and the Jedi and Sith orders *Descriptions and data for numerous starships, vehicles, weapons and other gear *A catalogue of NPC adversaries to thwart players during your campaign *A complete introductory adventure, ''Lessons from the Past'' *Helpful advice for GMs about running games of Force and Destiny ==Continuity== *On page 58, "[[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath mask]]" is misspelled as "antitox breath mask". *On pages 70, 82, 100 and 152, "[[Sun djem/Legends|Sun djem]]" is mispelled as "Sum djem". ==Development== The Core Rulebook was updated following the [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|beta playtest]]. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook}} ===Editions=== *{{ISBN|9781633441224}}; [[July 30]], [[2015]]; [[Fantasy Flight Games]]; US hardcover{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/products/star-wars-force-and-destiny/products/star-wars-force-and-destiny-core-rulebook|text=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook}} ===Cover gallery=== File:StarWars-ForceAndDestinyCoreRulebook.png|Full front cover File:FDCR_front_cover_art_by_Darren_Tan.png|Front cover art File:Ben_Kenobi_FDCR.png|Introduction
